# Factory-reset and pairing recovery

This patch release incorporates end-to-end hardware QA for factory-reset and
fresh-install flows, including recovery from intermittent BlueZ transport
timeouts.

## Changes

- retry a timed-out pairing transport up to three times with a longer BlueZ
  recovery window, without asking for the six-digit code again
- stop Bluetooth discovery as soon as the target watch is found, avoiding
  unnecessary controller scan traffic during code entry
- render the pairing code in the high-contrast foreground color and raise the
  pairing-screen brightness to at least 75%
- verify watch identity on every newly established BLE link, even when no
  profile settings have changed
- report ownership immediately after the watch accepts its first desktop
  profile
- retry Omarchy shell IPC during installation while plugin hot reloads make the
  shell briefly unavailable
- document that a factory-reset or replacement watch must be removed—not just
  disconnected—from BlueZ before pairing again
- explain why ordinary uninstall preserves the desktop owner identity and how
  to coordinate a complete reset of both sides

## Install or update

Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/iamjamesim/omarchy-watch#install).
The attached flash bundle supports Espressif esptool 4.x and 5.x. It writes the
three firmware regions separately, so routine upgrades preserve pairing, watch
settings, and the cached profile.

This is an independent community project for development hardware, not an
official Omarchy product or a waterproof consumer watch.
